stories.h: INEC official says some registration officers put AI-generated photos into voter register
stories.p: INEC's ICT director, Lawrence Bayode, has reportedly admitted that some registration officers with system access entered AI-generated and poor-quality photos into the preliminary voter register. He said INEC knows how it happened but not why, and that the register is still being cleaned up before certification in December.
body: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has reportedly admitted that artificial intelligence-generated photos found their way into Nigeria's preliminary voter register, and has blamed some of its own registration officers.
## What was said

Speaking on Arise Television, in comments reported on Friday, 30 October 2026, INEC's Director of Information and Communication Technology, Dr Lawrence Bayode, said some registration officers who had login access to the registration system introduced irregularities. He said some of the photos were AI-generated while others came from poor-quality registration, and that the problem was found in states across the country. He reportedly said the commission knew what the officers did and how they did it, but did not know why.
## How it was found

Bayode said INEC detected the problem by checking the database with its Automated Biometric Identification System, which compares faces and fingerprints to find duplicates and suspicious entries. He did not say how many records were affected.
## Background

INEC published the preliminary register online on 26 October, and social media users quickly shared screenshots of suspicious photos, including some from Edo State, as well as complaints about duplicate entries and missing names. INEC said on 27 October that it was examining and correcting the records, and that the online register was not final.
## What happens next

The commission says the register is still going through verification and correction, and that the final register is due to be certified on 15 December 2026. Bayode said INEC is working under pressure to finish the clean-up within the legal deadline. Opposition parties and civil society groups have called for a thorough audit before the January 2027 elections.
more: INEC says some registration officers entered AI-generated photos.
The problem was detected with its biometric identification system.
The final register is due for certification on 15 December.

stories.h: Zlatan's diss track 'Inferno' tops Apple Music Nigeria as VeryDarkMan responds
stories.p: Zlatan Ibile's new track 'Inferno', featuring Peruzzi and Shoday and reportedly aimed at VeryDarkMan, has topped the Apple Music Nigeria chart. VDM has mocked its success on his Instagram story, after earlier daring it to stay at number one for a month.
body: Rapper Zlatan Ibile has scored a chart-topping hit with a song widely seen as a response to social media activist VeryDarkMan (VDM), and VDM has not stayed quiet.
## The song

'Inferno', which features Peruzzi and Shoday, reportedly went to number one on the Apple Music Nigeria top songs chart and the Nigerian iTunes chart, according to reports on Friday, 30 October 2026. It also reportedly topped the chart in Sierra Leone. Fans have described it as a diss track aimed at VDM.
## VDM's response

VDM reacted on his Instagram story with mockery, brushing off the chart success. Before the song reached number one, he had sarcastically challenged it to stay at the top for a full month and described the buzz around it as forced publicity.
## Background

The feud between the two goes back to the period after the death of singer Mohbad in 2023, when VDM publicly pressured Zlatan and other music figures to speak out. More recently, VDM criticised Zlatan's high-profile wedding to Davita, claiming it was used to promote an album that did not do well. Zlatan has rarely responded directly, which is why many fans see 'Inferno' as his long-awaited reply.
## How people reacted

Many users mocked VDM's response, with some calling it damage control, while his supporters said the song's success would not last. VDM has been involved in several online disputes this week, including with businessman Blord, former BBNaija winner Phyna and Davido's camp.
more: 'Inferno' features Peruzzi and Shoday.
VDM dared the song to stay at number one for a month.
The feud dates back to the period after Mohbad's death.

stories.h: Kemi Badenoch hits back after being called a 'Nigerian scammer' online
stories.p: UK Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch has condemned online attacks referring to her Nigerian background, after a former adviser linked to Nigel Farage repeatedly called her a scammer. She said Britain is not a racist country and the attacks would not work, while Farage said the comment was over the top but not racist.
body: Kemi Badenoch, the Nigerian-raised leader of Britain's Conservative Party, has condemned online attacks that referred to her heritage, saying they show what kind of people her critics are.
## What happened

According to reports on Friday, 30 October 2026, Raheem Kassam, a former adviser linked to Nigel Farage's camp, repeatedly called Badenoch a scammer in social media posts over the weekend, mocking her Nigerian background and warning people not to give her their bank details. He also accused her of using her heritage to advance her career when it suited her.
## What Badenoch said

Speaking on a British breakfast television programme, Badenoch said some people in Reform UK appeared to think that attacking her race would help them. She said Britain is not a racist country and that such attacks would not work, and urged former Conservative voters who had switched to Reform to come back.
## Reform's response

Robert Jenrick, a former Conservative MP who has defected to Reform UK, reportedly declined to call the comments racist, describing them as perhaps rude or unpleasant. Badenoch said Jenrick was now Nigel Farage's problem. Farage said that mentioning that someone grew up in Nigeria was not racist, but later described Kassam's comment as over the top. A Labour spokesperson criticised Jenrick for not condemning the remarks.
## Background

Badenoch was born in London, grew up partly in Lagos and moved back to Britain as a teenager. She became Conservative leader in 2024. Reform UK has been rising in opinion polls, and several former Conservatives have joined the party, increasing tensions between the two.
more: A former Farage-linked adviser repeatedly called her a scammer.
Badenoch says Britain is not a racist country and the attacks will not work.

stories.h: AY Makun responds to backlash after missing Cardiff show, promises free return
stories.p: Comedian AY Makun has defended himself after failing to appear at his AY Live show in Cardiff, which led to calls for him to be cancelled. He blamed repeated problems on the tour and promised a free return show, while saying ticket holders will still get refunds.
body: Comedian and filmmaker Ayo 'AY' Makun has spoken out after facing a wave of criticism for not turning up at his AY Live show in Cardiff, Wales.
## What happened

Fans who bought tickets for the Cardiff show on Sunday were left angry when the comedian did not appear. Many criticised him on social media, and some called for him to be cancelled. AY had earlier apologised, saying fans' time, money and trust deserved respect, but the apology did not end the criticism.
## His side of the story

In a long statement reported on Friday, 30 October 2026, AY said veterans in the industry had advised him to stay quiet, but he felt his audience deserved an explanation. He said he had spent years performing at events where payment promises were broken, sometimes paying fellow performers from his own pocket. He said a five-hour drive from Sheffield to Cardiff, after repeated bad experiences on the same tour, became his breaking point, but added that the fans who turned up had done nothing wrong. He also complained that negative stories about him get more attention than his achievements, and said calls for cancellation would not make him give up.
## What he promised

AY said he would host a free return show in Cardiff, paid for by himself, once a venue and logistics are confirmed. He said this would not replace refunds owed to people who bought tickets for the original event.
## Background
AY is one of Nigeria's best-known comedians and has run the AY Live brand for many years, as well as producing hit films. His account of the tour problems has not been confirmed by the organisers.
more: AY says repeated problems on the tour led to his no-show.
He has promised a free return show in Cardiff.
Ticket holders are still owed refunds.

stories.h: Opposition coalition briefs Cardinal Onaiyekan on plan for a united front in 2027
stories.p: Leaders of the G100 coalition of opposition parties have visited Cardinal John Onaiyekan to brief him on their plan to present a united alternative in 2027. The cardinal backed the effort, and the coalition says it will unveil its reform programme at a summit on 9 November.
body: A coalition of opposition parties working towards a united front for the 2027 elections has received the backing of Cardinal John Onaiyekan, the retired Catholic Archbishop of Abuja.
## What happened

Leaders of the G100 coalition, made up of the national chairmen and secretaries of member parties, visited the cardinal at his residence on Thursday, 29 October 2026, according to a statement signed by Salihu Lukman on Friday. They briefed him on their progress, including bringing in more parties and setting up ways of resolving disagreements among members.
## What the cardinal said

Onaiyekan reportedly said he was pleased that Nigerians would have credible choices at the polls in 2027, and argued that the country's problems can only be solved by leaders who are competent, honest and compassionate. The coalition thanked him and asked him to keep praying for the initiative.
## The plan

The coalition says it is finalising three documents: a National Covenant for Democratic Renewal setting out its principles, a Framework for Opposition Unity describing how parties will work together, and a National Reform Programme setting out the policies a coalition government would pursue. These are expected to be endorsed at a second summit on Monday, 9 November 2026. The group says it will also visit other prominent Nigerians and foreign missions in the coming weeks.
## Background

Opposition figures have long argued that a divided opposition makes it easier for the ruling APC to win. Atiku Abubakar of the ADC and Peter Obi of the NDC are both running for president, and it is not yet clear what role, if any, either will play in the coalition.
more: Onaiyekan backed the effort and called for honest, competent leaders.
The coalition will unveil its reform programme on 9 November.
It is not clear what role Atiku or Obi will play.

stories.h: Ronaldo scores hat-trick for Al Nassr, now 15 goals short of 1,000
stories.p: Cristiano Ronaldo has reportedly scored a hat-trick in Al Nassr's 5-3 win over Al Kholood, taking his career total to 985 goals. He now needs 15 more to reach 1,000.
body: Cristiano Ronaldo is closing in on one of football's most remarkable milestones after scoring three goals in Al Nassr's latest win.
## What happened

The Portuguese forward reportedly scored in the 66th, 72nd and 81st minutes as Al Nassr beat Al Kholood 5-3 at their home ground in Riyadh, according to reports on Friday, 30 October 2026. The hat-trick took his career tally for club and country to 985 goals, leaving him 15 short of 1,000.
## Background

Ronaldo, 41, joined Al Nassr in 2023 and has continued to score regularly in the Saudi Pro League. He has said publicly that reaching 1,000 goals is one of his remaining goals before retirement. His career total includes goals for Sporting Lisbon, Manchester United, Real Madrid, Juventus, Al Nassr and Portugal, for whom he is the all-time leading international scorer.
## A big week
The hat-trick came in the same week that fans voted his 2007-08 season at Manchester United the greatest Ballon d'Or-winning season of all time in a poll run by France Football.
## What happens next
At his current scoring rate, Ronaldo could reach the 1,000-goal mark before the end of the season, and fans around the world will be counting down.
more: Ronaldo scored three times in a 5-3 win over Al Kholood.
He now has 985 career goals.
He needs 15 more to reach 1,000.

stories.h: "Igbo businessmen are ashamed of Blord": content creator Peter Mbah praises VeryDarkMan's marketing strategy
stories.p: Content creator Peter Mbah has criticised Blord's approach to marketing his power stations, saying VeryDarkMan has shown a better grasp of product promotion by documenting his Ratel units from production in China to live testing in Nigeria. He accused Blord of turning a business competition into a personal battle.
body: The business rivalry between entrepreneur Blord and social media activist VeryDarkMan (VDM) has taken another turn, with content creator Peter Mbah publicly criticising the way Blord is marketing his power stations.
## What Peter Mbah said

In a strongly worded statement, Peter Mbah said he was disappointed with what he called Blord's poor marketing strategy, and argued that VeryDarkMan has shown a better understanding of how to promote a product and engage customers.

He said Igbo businessmen are widely respected for their business intelligence, creativity and marketing skills, and questioned why Blord, despite his experience, seems more focused on social media confrontations than on convincing buyers of what his product can do.
## Why he praised VDM

According to Peter Mbah, VeryDarkMan has documented the whole journey of his Ratel power stations, from the production process in China to the arrival of the container in Nigeria and practical tests of the units on camera.
He said this approach has drawn public attention and helped build confidence among potential buyers.
## Blord was first, but VDM is louder
Peter Mbah also pointed out that Blord's power stations reportedly arrived in Nigeria before VDM's, yet VDM appears to be generating far more public discussion through his demonstrations.
He accused Blord of turning what should have been healthy business competition into a personal fight.
## The bigger lesson for Nigerian entrepreneurs

Beyond the rivalry, the row raises a wider question about how products are sold today. Customers increasingly want practical proof that a product can deliver what it promises. Showing how it performs, explaining its features and answering buyers' concerns can be more persuasive than trading insults with a competitor.
In the end, though, both brands will be judged on product quality, battery capacity, durability, price and customer satisfaction.
For Peter Mbah, VeryDarkMan has already taken the lead in winning public interest.
What do you think? Has VeryDarkMan outsmarted Blord in marketing, or is Blord simply using controversy to promote his own products?
more: Peter Mbah says VDM documented his Ratel power stations from production in China to live tests in Nigeria.
He noted that Blord's power stations reportedly arrived before VDM's.

stories.h: CAF scraps four-year plan, AFCON returns to every two years
stories.p: CAF has reversed its decision to hold the Africa Cup of Nations every four years and restored the traditional two-year cycle. President Patrice Motsepe says the move protects African football's interests, and AFCON 2027 in Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda goes ahead.
body: The Africa Cup of Nations will once again be played every two years after the Confederation of African Football (CAF) reversed its earlier decision to move the tournament to a four-year cycle.
## What happened

CAF's Executive Committee reportedly approved the change unanimously on Thursday, 29 October 2026, after months of discussion. CAF President Patrice Motsepe announced the decision in a statement on the body's website.
## Why CAF changed course

Motsepe said the decision was taken to advance and protect the interests of African football, its 54 member associations and African players at clubs abroad. CAF had planned to introduce an Africa Nations League to fill the gap between tournaments, but it was reportedly concerned about how long the new competition would take to deliver the expected money and development benefits. Returning to a two-year AFCON was seen as the safer option in the short term.
## What comes next

AFCON 2027 will be co-hosted by Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda. Motsepe said he was confident the three countries would deliver a successful competition. He described AFCON as more than a football tournament, calling it a celebration of African cultures that brings together people on the continent and in the diaspora.
## Background

AFCON has been held every two years for most of its history, which has sometimes caused friction with European clubs that lose key players in the middle of their seasons. The move to a four-year cycle had been welcomed by some clubs but criticised by many fans and smaller federations, who rely on tournament income.
## How fans reacted
Many African football fans, including Nigerians, welcomed the decision, saying more frequent AFCONs give the Super Eagles and other national teams more chances to compete for the title.
more: CAF's executive committee approved the change unanimously.
AFCON 2027 will be hosted by Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda.
Motsepe says the decision protects African football's interests.

stories.h: Binance reportedly hit by $6.3bn hack, the biggest crypto theft on record
stories.p: Crypto exchange Binance has reportedly lost about $6.3 billion in digital assets in a hack it says began with an engineer's compromised laptop. The exchange has frozen about $3 billion, promised to cover customers' losses and paused deposits and withdrawals. Investigators have linked the attack to a North Korean hacking group.
body: Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, has reportedly suffered a hack worth about $6.3 billion, which would make it the largest crypto theft ever recorded.
## What happened

Binance announced the breach on Thursday, 29 October 2026, and suspended deposits and withdrawals while it worked to contain the damage. Its preliminary investigation reportedly found that the attackers got in through a compromised laptop belonging to one of its engineers, and used that access to carry out unauthorised transactions. Founder Changpeng Zhao confirmed that the exchange appeared to have been the victim of a cyberattack.
## What Binance says

The exchange said about $3 billion of the stolen funds had already been frozen, although other reports put the frozen amount lower. Binance said it would cover all remaining losses, assured customers that their holdings were safe and said it was working with law enforcement. It promised a full technical report once its investigation is complete.
## Who is suspected

Blockchain analysis firm TRM said it believed with high confidence that the attack was carried out by TraderTraitor, a North Korean state-backed hacking unit linked to the Lazarus Group. The firm warned that the stolen money could be used to fund North Korea's weapons programmes. North Korea has not commented.
## Market impact

The price of Bitcoin reportedly fell by about 5 per cent to below $77,000 after news of the breach. The previous record crypto theft was about $1.5 billion stolen from the Bybit exchange in 2025, also blamed on North Korean hackers.
## Why it matters for Nigerians

Binance has millions of users in Africa, and Nigeria is one of the world's biggest markets for crypto trading. Users are being advised to watch for official updates from the exchange and to be wary of scammers posing as Binance support staff.
more: Binance says the hack began with an engineer's compromised laptop.
About $3bn has reportedly been frozen; Binance says it will cover losses.
Investigators link the attack to a North Korean hacking group.

stories.h: Dangote cuts petrol depot price to ₦1,290 as other marketers also reduce rates
stories.p: The Dangote Refinery has cut its petrol depot price in Lagos by ₦18 to ₦1,290 per litre, the lowest among major depots. Other depot owners in Lagos, Port Harcourt and Calabar have also reduced their prices.
body: Petrol depot prices are falling across Nigeria, with the Dangote Refinery now selling at the lowest rate among major depots in Lagos.
## The new prices

According to depot price data for Thursday, 29 October 2026, Dangote reduced its petrol price from ₦1,308 to ₦1,290 per litre, a cut of ₦18. Other Lagos depots followed with smaller reductions: Pinnacle and Rainoil now sell at about ₦1,300, African Terminal at about ₦1,307, and MRS and NIPCO at about ₦1,310. In Port Harcourt, several depots cut their prices to about ₦1,325, while depots in Calabar sell at between ₦1,330 and ₦1,335.
## Diesel prices
The petrol cut came shortly after Dangote raised its diesel gantry price to ₦1,840 per litre. Some Lagos depots have since undercut that price, selling diesel at about ₦1,825.
## What it means for motorists

Depot prices are what marketers pay before transporting fuel to filling stations, so the cuts could lead to slightly lower pump prices in the coming days if retailers pass on the savings. However, pump prices also depend on transport costs and each marketer's margins, so the effect may vary from place to place.
## Background

Since petrol subsidies were removed in 2023, prices have been set by the market and change often in response to crude oil prices and the exchange rate. The Dangote Refinery, which began selling petrol in 2024, has become a major influence on local prices. Cooking gas and diesel prices have also been rising, putting pressure on households and businesses.
more: Dangote's Lagos depot price fell from ₦1,308 to ₦1,290.
Other depots in Lagos, Port Harcourt and Calabar also cut prices.

stories.h: Utomi says an Obi government would aim for ₦500 to the dollar
stories.p: NDC chieftain Pat Utomi has reportedly said Peter Obi's economic plan would aim to strengthen the naira to ₦500 per dollar, from about ₦1,350 today. He claimed this would sharply cut food and fuel prices, but the party has not said how long it would take.
body: Political economist Pat Utomi, a leading figure in the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), has reportedly said that a Peter Obi government would work towards an exchange rate of ₦500 to the dollar.
## What he said

In a post on X reported on Friday, 30 October 2026, Utomi said the target would be part of Obi's economic agenda. He argued that the naira could be strengthened from its current rate of about ₦1,350 to ₦500 per dollar through investment in security, electricity and roads, together with market reforms. He also projected large falls in the prices of everyday goods, claiming for example that a 50kg bag of imported rice could drop from about ₦55,000 to ₦27,500 and a loaf of sliced bread from ₦1,750 to ₦800.
## The questions

The NDC has not said how long such an improvement would take, or what monetary and fiscal steps would be used to achieve and sustain it. Reaching ₦500 would require the naira to gain about 63 per cent against the dollar. The naira traded at about ₦1,347 on the official market and around ₦1,385 on the parallel market at the end of last week. No independent economists or government officials had responded to the target at the time of the report.
## Background

The exchange rate has been one of the biggest economic issues since the naira was floated in 2023, when it weakened sharply. The Tinubu government says its reforms have stabilised the currency, while the opposition argues that the weaker naira has driven up living costs. Utomi, who once ran for president himself, is a long-time ally of Obi.
## How people reacted
Obi's supporters welcomed the promise, while critics described it as unrealistic and questioned how it could be achieved without large reserves.
more: Utomi says the target is ₦500 to the dollar, from about ₦1,350 now.
He projected big falls in food and fuel prices.
The NDC has not given a timeline.

stories.h: Phyna and VeryDarkMan trade words after his reported comment about her
stories.p: Former BBNaija winner Phyna has hit back at VeryDarkMan during an Instagram Live session, after he reportedly reacted to a blog post that insulted her. Fans are divided, with some criticising her for bringing his family into the row.
body: Former Big Brother Naija winner Phyna and social media activist VeryDarkMan (VDM) are the latest stars to clash online, in a row that has split their fans.
## What happened

According to reports on Friday, 30 October 2026, the trouble began after VDM allegedly commented on a blogger's post that used an insulting term about Phyna. The post followed an Instagram Live discussion earlier in the week about the school project VDM says he funded with Burna Boy, in which Phyna had taken part alongside socialite King Mitchy. VDM's exact words have not been published.
## Phyna's response

Phyna responded during another Instagram Live session on Thursday, 29 October. She rejected the insulting label and then turned on VDM personally, including making remarks about his family. She said she had mostly been listening during the earlier session while King Mitchy did most of the talking, and felt she had been dragged into the matter.
## How people reacted

Fans were divided. Some said Phyna had every right to defend herself, while others criticised her for bringing VDM's mother into the dispute. Some users accused celebrities of using VDM's name to trend. VDM had not publicly responded to her comments at the time of the report.
## Background

VDM is one of Nigeria's most talked-about online figures and has had public disputes with many celebrities. He is currently promoting his Ratel power stations business and has been involved in rows with businessman Blord and with Davido's camp. Phyna won the seventh season of BBNaija in 2022 and has often been in the news over her outspoken posts.
more: Phyna responded to VDM during an Instagram Live.
Fans criticised her for bringing VDM's family into the row.
VDM has not publicly responded.

stories.h: Mohbad's family asks for DNA test delay, wants details of US lab
stories.p: The family of late singer Mohbad has asked for the DNA test on his son to be postponed until it is told which US laboratory will analyse the samples. The family says it is not opposing the test but wants transparency. The test was scheduled for Saturday in Lagos.
body: The family of the late singer Ilerioluwa 'Mohbad' Aloba has asked for the planned DNA test on his son, Liam, to be put on hold until it receives more information about how the samples will be handled.
## What the family wants

In a statement signed by family head Samuel Aloba on Thursday, 29 October 2026, the family asked for the identity, address and accreditation of the laboratory in the United States that will analyse the samples. It also asked whether the Lagos State DNA and Forensic Centre would carry out the test itself or only collect samples to be sent abroad, and requested clear procedures to protect the samples on their journey. The family asked that all parties be given proper notice and that the court give further directions if needed.
## Not opposing the test

The family said it was not against the paternity test and was not claiming that anything improper had happened. It said it only wanted transparency and safeguards to prevent any possible mishandling. The test had been scheduled to take place on Saturday, 31 October, at a hospital in Yaba, Lagos. It is not yet clear whether it will go ahead as planned.
## Background

Mohbad died on 12 September 2023 at the age of 27, and his death sparked nationwide protests and calls for justice. The paternity of his son has since been the subject of a bitter dispute between his father, Joseph Aloba, and his widow, Omowunmi. A Lagos court ordered in May 2026 that the test be carried out by the Lagos State DNA and Forensic Centre.
## What happens next
The widow's camp had not responded to the latest demand at the time of the report. Further court directions may be needed if the test is delayed.
more: The family wants to know which US lab will analyse the samples.
It says it is not opposing the test.
The test was scheduled for Saturday in Lagos.

stories.h: Osimhen and partner Stefanie welcome second daughter
stories.p: Super Eagles striker Victor Osimhen and his partner Stefanie Ladewig have welcomed a baby girl, reportedly named Liora Audrey. His club Galatasaray shared the news on social media on Thursday.
body: Super Eagles striker Victor Osimhen is a father again after his partner, Stefanie Ladewig, gave birth to a baby girl.
## What happened

His club, Galatasaray, announced the birth on social media on Thursday, 29 October 2026, congratulating the striker and Stefanie on the arrival of their daughter. The baby has reportedly been named Liora Audrey. The exact date of birth was not given.
## Background

It is the couple's second child. Their first daughter, Hailey, was born in October 2022. The good news comes during a strong spell for Osimhen on the pitch. He scored twice in Galatasaray's derby win over Fenerbahçe on Monday and is closing in on the club's record for goals by a foreign player, with 68 goals so far.
## How fans reacted
Nigerian and Turkish fans flooded social media with congratulations, with many joking that the new baby had brought him luck in front of goal.
more: The baby girl has reportedly been named Liora Audrey.
It is the couple's second daughter after Hailey, born in 2022.
Galatasaray announced the news on Thursday.

stories.h: Star Trek and X-Men actor Sir Patrick Stewart dies at 86
stories.p: Sir Patrick Stewart, famous as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek and Professor Charles Xavier in the X-Men films, has died at his home in Los Angeles at the age of 86. His spokesperson said he died on Wednesday after living with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy body dementia.
body: Sir Patrick Stewart, the British actor who became a global star as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation, has reportedly died at the age of 86. He passed away on Wednesday, 28 October 2026, at his home in Los Angeles.
## What was announced

His spokesperson, Kelly Bush Novak, shared a statement on Instagram on Thursday saying the actor died from Alzheimer's disease and Lewy body dementia, in the care of his wife, Sunny, and surrounded by family and friends. The family described his final stage as a short and moving journey and said his grace would be remembered.
## His life and career

Stewart was born in Mirfield in Yorkshire, England, and began his career with the Royal Shakespeare Company. Over six decades he worked on stage, in film and on television. He reached millions of viewers as Captain Picard and later as Professor Charles Xavier, the leader of the mutants in the X-Men films. Despite his screen fame, he spent much of his career in the theatre, playing roles such as Macbeth and Claudius, and performing his own one-man version of A Christmas Carol. With his close friend Sir Ian McKellen, he starred in West End and Broadway productions of Waiting for Godot and No Man's Land, swapping roles between them.
## Why it matters

Stewart was one of the few actors equally admired by Shakespeare lovers and science fiction fans. He returned to the role of Picard in a later television series and was knighted for services to drama. Fans around the world, including in Nigeria, shared clips of his most famous scenes as news of his death spread.
## What happens next
Details of funeral arrangements have not been announced. Tributes from colleagues are expected in the coming days.
more: He died at home in Los Angeles on Wednesday.
He was best known as Captain Picard and Professor X.
He spent much of his career on stage with the Royal Shakespeare Company.

stories.h: Putin tells Europe Russia is 'ready for war' but warns there would be no winners
stories.p: Russian President Vladimir Putin has reportedly said Russia does not want a war with Europe but is ready for one, warning that nobody would win if tensions escalate. He spoke at a Russia–Africa summit in Moscow attended by delegations from 48 countries.
body: Russian President Vladimir Putin has issued a fresh warning to European countries, reportedly saying Russia is ready for war with Europe even though it does not want one.
## What he said

Speaking at a Russia–Africa summit in Moscow, reported on Thursday, 29 October 2026, Putin is said to have told any European country seeking a conflict to prepare for it, and warned that if things escalated there would be no winners at all. He argued that Western efforts to defeat Russia strategically had failed. He also said Moscow did not want the Baltic Sea to face disruption like that seen in the Strait of Hormuz during the recent Iran war, which pushed up fuel prices around the world.
## The summit

The meeting was attended by 48 countries, including 22 heads of state, according to reports. African countries have deepened trade and security ties with Russia in recent years, and the summit was seen as part of Moscow's effort to keep its influence on the continent.
## Background

Tensions between Russia and NATO countries have risen in recent months. Several European governments have accused Russia of sabotage, surveillance of undersea cables and drone incursions into their airspace, including over Latvia and Estonia. Germany raised its assessment of the risk of war with Russia earlier this month. Meanwhile, the war in Ukraine continues, and a Russian strike on a railway station was reported to have killed 14 people this week, an attack Ukraine's president condemned.
## What happens next
European leaders are expected to respond to the remarks, and NATO is likely to keep up its patrols in the Baltic region.
more: Putin says Russia does not want war but is ready for it.
He warned there would be 'no winners' if tensions escalate.
He spoke at a Russia–Africa summit attended by 48 countries.

stories.h: Ronaldo's 2007-08 season voted greatest in Ballon d'Or history
stories.p: Cristiano Ronaldo has thanked fans after his 2007-08 season at Manchester United was voted the greatest Ballon d'Or-winning season of all time in a public vote. Lionel Messi's 2012 season came second.
body: Cristiano Ronaldo has received a special 'Ballon d'Or of All Time' honour after fans voted his 2007-08 season at Manchester United the greatest in the history of the award.
## What happened

The prize was reportedly presented by France Football, the magazine that runs the Ballon d'Or, after a month-long public online vote. The result was reported on Thursday, 29 October 2026. Lionel Messi's 2012 season finished second, while Ronaldo's own 2017 season came third.
## The winning season

In 2007-08, Ronaldo scored 42 goals in all competitions and helped Manchester United win both the Premier League and the Champions League. That season earned him his first Ballon d'Or, the start of a long rivalry with Messi that saw the two players dominate the award for more than a decade.
## What Ronaldo said
The Portuguese star thanked fans around the world on social media, saying football belongs to the fans and that the award belongs to them too.
## How fans reacted

The result reignited the endless debate between supporters of Ronaldo and Messi. Ronaldo's fans celebrated the win as proof of his greatness, while Messi supporters pointed out that the Argentine has won more Ballon d'Or titles in total. The honour comes days after England captain Harry Kane won this year's Ballon d'Or.
more: Fans voted his 2007-08 Manchester United season the best ever.
Messi's 2012 season finished second.
Ronaldo said football and the award belong to the fans.

stories.h: D'Banj shares emotional tribute to late son Daniel
stories.p: Singer D'Banj has shared a heartfelt message to his late son Daniel, saying he misses him and that the family has found a safe place in their healing. The boy drowned in 2018 when he was 13 months old.
body: Nigerian music star D'Banj has opened up about the loss of his son in an emotional post that touched many of his fans.
## What he wrote

In an Instagram post shared on Thursday, 29 October 2026, the singer told his late son, Daniel, that he missed him and said he could not imagine what the boy's mother had been through. He wrote that the family had reached a safe space in their healing, alongside his wife, Lineo, and their other children. He thanked his son for teaching him what life really means, said he believed the boy was proud of the family, and asked him to greet his late uncle Femi. The post included several photos of father and son together.
## Background

D'Banj's son, Daniel Oyebanjo III, drowned in June 2018 at the family home in Lagos when he was 13 months old. The tragedy shocked the entertainment industry, and the singer and his wife received messages of support from fans and colleagues at the time. D'Banj, one of the pioneers of modern Nigerian pop music, has spoken in the past about how the loss changed his life and his faith.
## How people reacted
Fans and fellow celebrities flooded the comments with prayers and messages of comfort, praising the singer for speaking openly about grief and healing.
more: D'Banj says the family has found a 'safe space' in their healing.
His son drowned in 2018 at 13 months old.
Fans sent messages of comfort.

stories.h: NLC and TUC clash over Tinubu's ₦70,000 transport allowance
stories.p: NLC president Joe Ajaero has reportedly criticised the TUC for rejecting the government's ₦70,000 transport allowance, saying it did not take part in negotiating the deal. The TUC has demanded a ₦300,000 minimum wage, while Atiku says the allowance is too small.
body: Nigeria's two main labour centres are at odds over the Federal Government's ₦70,000 transport allowance for workers, exposing divisions within organised labour.
## What happened

In comments reported on Friday, 30 October 2026, Nigeria Labour Congress (NLC) president Joe Ajaero is said to have rebuked the Trade Union Congress (TUC) for rejecting the allowance. He reportedly argued that the TUC did not sign the agreement and should not oppose something it did not negotiate. Ajaero described the allowance, which the NLC says will last six months, as an important step to help workers cope with higher petrol prices and living costs, and said it could serve as a reference for future negotiations.
## The TUC's position
The TUC has rejected the allowance and is reportedly demanding a ₦300,000 national minimum wage instead.
## A temporary fix

Ajaero stressed that the allowance is not a permanent solution and warned that the six months must not run out before a new minimum wage framework is agreed. He said future wage talks should take account of transport, food, housing and other basic costs. Earlier this week he said a ₦1 million minimum wage would collapse the economy.
## Opposition reaction

ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar has rejected the allowance as far too small, with his campaign questioning what a month's worth of support could buy in fuel. His campaign also said private sector workers, traders and informal workers are left out.
## What happens next
Talks on a new minimum wage are expected to continue, and the split between the NLC and TUC could affect labour's bargaining power.
more: Ajaero says the TUC did not negotiate the deal.

stories.h: Okorocha calls Obi's one-term pledge a 'dangerous gamble' and backs Tinubu
stories.p: Former Imo governor Rochas Okorocha has reportedly described Peter Obi's promise to serve only one four-year term as a dangerous gamble for the South East. Speaking on television, he urged the region to choose its alliances carefully and backed President Tinubu's re-election.
body: Former Imo State governor Rochas Okorocha has criticised Peter Obi's plan to serve a single four-year term if elected president, reportedly calling it a dangerous gamble.
## What he said

Speaking on a Channels Television politics programme on Thursday, 29 October 2026, Okorocha is said to have questioned whether Obi's one-term model would work and urged the South East to be careful and strategic in choosing political alliances rather than backing what he described as risky options. He also backed President Bola Tinubu's re-election, arguing that the President had not acted against the interests of the Igbo people and was a more reliable choice for the region.
## Background

Obi, the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) presidential candidate, has promised to serve only one term, a pledge his supporters say shows he is not driven by personal ambition. Critics, including Works Minister David Umahi, have argued that the South East should aim for eight years in power like other regions. Okorocha's comments came on the same day a Federal High Court ordered INEC to recognise him as the APC candidate for the Imo West Senate seat in place of Governor Hope Uzodimma, and former APC chairman Abdullahi Ganduje visited him to congratulate him.
## How people reacted
Obi's supporters dismissed the comments as politically motivated, while APC supporters shared the clip widely. The Obi campaign had not responded at the time of the report.
## What happens next
The debate over whether the South East should back Obi or Tinubu is likely to grow as both camps campaign across the region.
more: Okorocha says Obi's one-term promise is risky for the South East.
He backed Tinubu's re-election.

stories.h: Agbara Nla: The Return earns over $170,000 abroad ahead of US release
stories.p: Mike Bamiloye's faith film Agbara Nla: The Return has reportedly earned about $173,650 in the UK, Ireland and Canada and opens in US cinemas on Friday. It has made ₦408 million in Nigeria and topped the local box office for four weekends.
body: The faith-based Nollywood film Agbara Nla: The Return is reportedly breaking records abroad as it prepares to open in cinemas across the United States.
## The figures

According to the film's distributor, the movie has earned about $173,650 across the UK, Ireland and Canada, including about £86,700 from the UK and Ireland and about CAD$82,200 from Canada. The distributor claims it recorded the biggest opening weekend ever for a Nollywood film in the UK, as well as record pre-sales. These figures come from the distributor and have not been independently verified. In Nigeria, the film has grossed about ₦408 million, making it the second-highest-grossing Nollywood film of 2026, and has held the number one spot for four weekends in a row.
## US release
The film opens in American cinemas on Friday, 30 October 2026, with tickets available through major cinema chains, the distributor announced on Instagram this week.
## Background

Agbara Nla: The Return is a modern retelling of the 1993 classic Agbara Nla by Mount Zion Faith Ministries founder Mike Bamiloye, who reprises his role as the herbalist Isawuru. The original film is one of the best-known Christian movies in Nigeria and was watched by millions on video. The new version has drawn church groups and families to cinemas in large numbers.
## Why it matters
The film's success abroad shows the growing audience for Nigerian faith-based stories among the diaspora, and could encourage more Nollywood releases in foreign cinemas.
more: The film has made about $173,650 in the UK, Ireland and Canada.
It has grossed ₦408m in Nigeria.
It opens in US cinemas on Friday.

stories.h: NNPC ready to resume oil exploration in Borno after two-year pause
stories.p: NNPC Limited says it is prepared to restart oil exploration in Borno State after operations were halted for more than two years. Governor Babagana Zulum promised security support but asked the company to restore gas supply and upgrade idle equipment first.
body: Nigeria's national oil company, NNPC Limited, says it is ready to restart oil exploration in Borno State, more than two years after work stopped.
## What happened

An NNPC delegation led by its chairman, Ahmadu Musa Kida, and Group Chief Executive Officer Bashir Ojulari met Governor Babagana Zulum at Government House in Maiduguri on Wednesday, according to reports published on Friday, 30 October 2026. The company said it was prepared to resume exploration in an oil basin covering seven local government areas of the state and to work with the state government and local communities. No date for the restart was given. The two sides also discussed a planned solar power project.
## Zulum's conditions

Zulum reportedly pledged full support for the operations and rejected the idea that insecurity caused the suspension, saying soldiers, police and members of the Civilian Joint Task Force were already guarding the sites and equipment. Before work fully resumes, he asked NNPC to honour an earlier promise to supply gas to the state, saying its withdrawal was a key reason for the stoppage, and to upgrade equipment that has been lying idle for more than two years. He also backed more solar plants to protect residents from rising fuel costs.
## Background

The search for oil in the North East has long been part of government efforts to diversify Nigeria's oil production away from the Niger Delta. Exploration in Borno was disrupted for years by the Boko Haram insurgency, and oil workers were attacked in the area in 2017.
## What happens next
NNPC is expected to work out a timetable with the state government once the conditions are discussed further.
more: NNPC says it is ready to resume exploration in seven LGAs.
Zulum wants gas supply restored and equipment upgraded first.
No restart date has been announced.

stories.h: Obi tells Ebonyi town hall Nigerians should not vote for leaders who stay at home while people suffer
stories.p: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi has reportedly told a town hall in Ebonyi State that voters should reject candidates who do not know the communities they want to lead. He said leadership should come from the people's demand, not be imposed on them.
body: Peter Obi, the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), took his campaign to Ebonyi State on Thursday, 29 October 2026, where he reportedly told a town hall meeting that Nigerians should not vote for politicians who stay in their homes while ordinary people suffer.
## What he said

According to reports, Obi said some of the people seeking the presidency could not find places such as Abakaliki, Ikwo and Nkalagu on a map, and did not understand the problems facing people in those communities. He argued that leaders must engage directly with citizens and listen to their needs, and said leadership should come from the demand of the people rather than being supplied to them by a few. The meeting was organised to hear residents' concerns first-hand.
## Background

The Ebonyi visit came a day after Obi's town hall in Nasarawa State, where he said election riggers would be jailed under his government, and on the same day Oyo governor Seyi Makinde told a meeting in Enugu that his team had been warned against campaigning in the South East because it is seen as Obi's stronghold. Obi, a former Anambra governor, won most of the South East in 2023 as the Labour Party candidate and is now running with Rabiu Kwankwaso on the NDC ticket.
## How people reacted

Supporters shared clips from the meeting widely online. Some commenters claimed that tricycle operators were restricted around the venue, but these claims have not been confirmed. The APC and other parties have not responded to his latest remarks.
## What happens next
Obi is expected to continue his tour of the South East and North Central in the coming days as campaigning for the January 2027 elections intensifies.
more: Obi named Abakaliki, Ikwo and Nkalagu as places some aspirants do not know.
He said leadership should come from the people's demand.
The visit followed his Nasarawa town hall on Wednesday.

stories.h: Ganduje visits Okorocha to congratulate him after court ruling on Imo West ticket
stories.p: Former APC national chairman Abdullahi Ganduje has reportedly visited Rochas Okorocha to congratulate him after a Federal High Court in Abuja ordered INEC to recognise Okorocha, not Governor Hope Uzodimma, as the party's Imo West senatorial candidate. Ganduje is said to have described the ruling as a reason to celebrate.
body: The fight over the APC ticket for the Imo West Senatorial District has drawn in a major party figure, with former APC national chairman Abdullahi Ganduje reportedly visiting former Imo governor Rochas Okorocha to congratulate him on his court victory.
## What happened

According to reports on Thursday, 29 October 2026, Ganduje, a former governor of Kano State, visited Okorocha to celebrate the judgment. He is said to have told Okorocha he was excited when he heard about the ruling and described it as a reason for celebration. No direct statement from Okorocha about the visit has been reported.
## The court ruling

A Federal High Court sitting in Abuja ruled that Governor Hope Uzodimma should stop presenting himself as the APC candidate for Imo West and directed the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to publish Okorocha's name instead. Okorocha had gone to court claiming he won the party's primary on 18 May with about 150,780 votes to Uzodimma's 102,158, while the returning officer had declared Uzodimma the winner with 230,464 votes. The case also raises the question of whether a sitting governor, whose term runs until January 2028, can contest a Senate seat in 2027.
## Background

Okorocha governed Imo from 2011 to 2019 and has had a long-running rivalry with Uzodimma, who succeeded him after a Supreme Court judgment in 2020. Uzodimma has been campaigning for President Tinubu's re-election and has rejected the Rainbow Coalition in the state.
## What happens next
Uzodimma has not publicly responded to the visit, and it is not yet clear whether he will appeal. The ruling is expected to deepen divisions within the Imo APC ahead of the 2027 elections.
more: Ganduje reportedly called the judgment a reason for celebration.
The court ordered INEC to publish Okorocha's name for Imo West.
Uzodimma has not said whether he will appeal.

stories.h: Nigerian stock market hits record high as Dangote Cement jumps nearly 6%
stories.p: The Nigerian Exchange All-Share Index closed at a record 254,083 points on Thursday, with market value rising to about ₦165 trillion. Dangote Cement gained 5.82% to lead the rally.
body: The Nigerian stock market closed at a new all-time high on Thursday, 29 October 2026, as gains in Dangote Cement and other large companies pushed investors' wealth higher.
## The numbers

The Nigerian Exchange (NGX) All-Share Index rose by 0.47 per cent to close at 254,083.02 points, according to reports. The total value of listed shares climbed to about ₦164.97 trillion, up from ₦164.19 trillion the day before, a gain of about ₦779 billion. That beat the previous record of about ₦164.91 trillion set on 27 October.
## Who led the rally

Dangote Cement, one of the largest companies on the exchange, gained 5.82 per cent to close at ₦1,420 per share, and helped lift the industrial goods index by more than 3 per cent. Among smaller stocks, payment company eTranzact rose by 10 per cent, while Sovereign Trust Insurance, FTG Insurance, McNichols and Zichis Agro-Allied Industries also posted strong gains.
## Background

Nigerian stocks have performed strongly this year as investors respond to falling inflation, a more stable naira and strong company earnings. Inflation fell to 14.63 per cent in September, according to official figures cited by the government, and external reserves have risen to about $55 billion.
## What it means
For ordinary investors, the record high means the value of many shareholdings has risen sharply, although analysts often warn that markets can fall quickly after strong rallies.
more: The All-Share Index closed at 254,083.02 points.
Market value rose by about ₦779 billion in a day.
Dangote Cement gained 5.82% to ₦1,420.

stories.h: Tiwa Savage hits back at critic who mocked her age over 'African Baddie' single
stories.p: Tiwa Savage has responded to a social media user who said she was too old to call herself a 'baddie', correcting him that she is 46 and listing her achievements. Her new single 'African Baddie' is due out on Friday.
body: Afrobeats star Tiwa Savage has fired back at a man who mocked her age over the title of her new single, 'African Baddie', in an exchange that quickly went viral.
## What happened

On Thursday, 29 October 2026, a social media user reportedly questioned why a woman of 40 would call herself a 'baddie' and suggested she was not serious. Replying in a single post, the singer corrected him, saying she is actually 46, listed her achievements and described herself as unbothered. She asked what exactly his problem was and used the same post to promote her new release.
## The new single
'African Baddie' is scheduled for release on Friday, 30 October. The singer has long presented herself as Africa's 'bad girl', and the title builds on that image.
## Background

Tiwa Savage is one of Africa's most successful female artists. She has won major awards, signed with Universal Music Group and performed at the coronation concert of King Charles III in 2023. Her career spans more than a decade of hit songs, and she has frequently spoken about ageism and the pressure on women in the music industry.
## How people reacted

Fans rallied behind the singer, praising her confidence and saying age should not limit how women express themselves. Others joked that the critic had given her free promotion a day before the song's release.
more: Tiwa says she is 46 and 'unbothered'.
'African Baddie' is due out on Friday, 30 October.
Fans praised her response to the critic.

stories.h: Dachung Bagos wins APC rerun primary for Jos South/Jos East seat
stories.p: Former lawmaker Dachung Bagos has reportedly won the APC rerun primary for the Jos South/Jos East federal constituency in Plateau State with 12,181 votes. The rerun was ordered after a court nullified the first primary over alleged irregularities in 11 wards.
body: Former House of Representatives member Dachung Bagos has won the All Progressives Congress (APC) rerun primary for the Jos South/Jos East Federal Constituency in Plateau State, according to results announced on Thursday, 29 October 2026.
## The result

The chairman of the rerun electoral committee, Simon Elisha, reportedly announced at the party's state secretariat in Jos that Bagos polled 12,181 votes, while his rival, Esther Simi Dusu, received 2,495 votes, a margin of almost 10,000. The rerun was held on Wednesday in 11 wards, including Du, Shen, Turu, Federe and Shere.
## Why there was a rerun

A High Court in Jos had nullified the original primary for the seat after finding alleged irregularities in the 11 affected wards and ordered fresh voting in those areas. With the rerun result, Bagos is set to be the APC candidate for the seat in the 2027 general election.
## Background

Bagos represented Jos South/Jos East in the House of Representatives before, and is a well-known figure in Plateau politics. Party primaries across the country have produced many court cases this year, with several candidates replaced or ordered to face reruns. The Plateau constituency has seen strong contests between the major parties in recent elections.
## What happens next
It is not yet known whether the losing candidate will challenge the result. INEC is expected to update its list of candidates once the party submits the name.
more: Bagos polled 12,181 votes to Esther Simi Dusu's 2,495.
A court had nullified the first primary in 11 wards.
Bagos is set to contest the seat in 2027.

stories.h: Makinde takes campaign to Enugu despite warnings about Obi's stronghold, questions Tinubu's Saudi trip
stories.p: Oyo governor Seyi Makinde, who is running for president on the APM ticket, told a town hall in Enugu that his team was almost talked out of campaigning in the South East because it is seen as Peter Obi's territory. He also asked the Presidency to explain the real purpose of President Tinubu's trip to Saudi Arabia.
body: Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde, the presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM) for 2027, has taken his campaign to the South East, telling supporters in Enugu that his team was almost discouraged from coming to a region widely seen as Peter Obi's base. On the same day, he raised questions about President Bola Tinubu's trip to Saudi Arabia.
## What he said in Enugu

Speaking at an APM town hall meeting in Enugu on Thursday, 29 October 2026, Makinde said people had warned his team against campaigning in the South East because the zone was regarded as belonging completely to Obi, the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) candidate. He said he decided to bring his message there anyway and urged Nigerians to reject politics that divides people along ethnic and tribal lines.
## His question about Tinubu's trip

In a video shared the same day by an Oyo affairs account on X, Makinde said he had read on social media that the President was travelling to Saudi Arabia to pray for Nigeria. He remarked that prayers can be answered from within Nigeria too, and asked the Presidency to tell Nigerians the true situation. He did not say what he believed the situation to be.
## How people reacted

Reactions online were divided. Some users backed his call for openness, while others accused him of politicising a religious trip, and one asked whether he was wishing the President ill because of the election. The Presidency has said the President is performing Umrah, and an aide has rejected claims that the trip is for medical treatment.
## Background

Obi won most of the South East in the 2023 presidential election and remains very popular there. Makinde, who is serving his second and final term as Oyo governor, is one of several candidates now trying to build support across regions. Tinubu left Abuja for Makkah this week, and Atiku Abubakar and activist Omoyele Sowore have also questioned the trip.
more: Makinde says his team was warned against campaigning in the South East.
He asked the Presidency to explain the real purpose of Tinubu's trip.
Some users accused him of politicising the President's Umrah.

stories.h: Tinubu defends new loans, says debt should be judged by what it builds
stories.p: President Bola Tinubu has defended his government's borrowing in a new essay, arguing that loans should be judged by the roads, power and ports they deliver. He listed major projects and economic figures and said Nigeria cannot reach a $1 trillion economy by 2030 on old infrastructure. Atiku Abubakar has again criticised the borrowing plan.
body: President Bola Tinubu has responded to criticism of his government's borrowing plans, saying the real test of debt is what it produces rather than how large it is. His essay, titled 'From Reforms to Delivery', was released in Abuja on Thursday, 29 October 2026, and shared on X by his adviser on information and strategy, Bayo Onanuga.
## What he said

Tinubu reportedly argued that the key question is not how much Nigeria borrows but what the country builds and leaves behind. He listed projects including the Lagos–Calabar Coastal Highway, the Sokoto–Badagry Superhighway, the Trans-Sahara Highway, upgrades to the electricity grid and the modernisation of ports in Lagos, as well as spending on health, education and skills. He said the coastal highway alone could cut logistics costs on the corridor by 15 to 20 per cent, add up to 2 per cent to GDP and create about 100,000 construction jobs.
## The figures he cited

The President pointed to growth of 4.43 per cent in the second quarter, inflation of 14.63 per cent in September compared with about 21 per cent a year earlier, external reserves of about $55 billion and a tax-to-GDP ratio of 12.5 per cent. He credited the removal of the petrol subsidy, the unification of exchange rates and tax reforms. He said a $1 trillion economy by 2030 cannot run on infrastructure built for a much smaller economy, and named food affordability and energy prices among his priorities for the next phase.
## The criticism

The essay follows the President's request to the Senate for approval to borrow about $20.5 billion and €1 billion. Atiku Abubakar, the ADC presidential candidate, said the request proved an earlier warning he gave, and has accused the government of piling up debt, which he says now stands at about ₦167 trillion. He has asked for details of how previous loans were spent.
## What happens next
The Senate is yet to approve the new borrowing plan, and the debate over debt is expected to be a major theme of the 2027 campaign.
more: Tinubu says loans should be judged by what they build.
He cites inflation of 14.63% and reserves of about $55bn.

stories.h: NLC president Ajaero says a ₦1m minimum wage would collapse the economy
stories.p: NLC president Joe Ajaero has reportedly said a ₦1 million monthly minimum wage would collapse Nigeria's economy. He said the focus should be on bringing down living costs and strengthening the naira, as talks on wages continue.
body: The president of the Nigeria Labour Congress (NLC), Joe Ajaero, has reportedly said that a minimum wage of ₦1 million a month would bring down the Nigerian economy, in comments that surprised many workers.
## What he said

Speaking in an interview on Channels Television, reported on Thursday, 29 October 2026, Ajaero is said to have argued that the priority should be lowering the cost of living and improving the value of the naira rather than chasing very large pay figures. He reportedly said that without tackling inflation, the weak currency and high living costs, bigger salaries on paper would not make workers better off, and that government must first take steps to stabilise the economy.
## Background

Labour unions and the Federal Government are still discussing a review of the national minimum wage, which was raised to ₦70,000 a month in 2024. Some workers and activists have called for a much higher figure because of rising prices. The government recently approved a ₦70,000 monthly transport allowance for public workers to ease the impact of high fuel prices, a move that the opposition criticised as too small.
## How people reacted

The comments drew mixed reactions online. Some users said the NLC leader was being realistic about what the economy can afford, while others said labour should be pressing for the highest possible increase at a time when food and transport costs have risen sharply.
## What happens next
Talks between labour and the government are expected to continue, with wages likely to become a major issue in the run-up to the 2027 elections.
more: Ajaero says lower living costs matter more than a bigger pay figure.
The minimum wage review is still under discussion.
Some workers criticised his comments.

stories.h: CBN warns banks to store payment data in Nigeria by January 2027
stories.p: The Central Bank of Nigeria says banks and other regulated firms must store critical payment data inside the country by 1 January 2027, and that the deadline will not move. Firms that fail to comply face sanctions.
body: The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) has told banks and other financial institutions that the deadline for keeping critical payment transaction data inside Nigeria remains 1 January 2027.
## What happened

The CBN Deputy Governor for Financial System Stability, Lamido Abubakar Yuguda, gave the warning at a regulatory meeting in Lagos organised with the National Information Technology Development Agency (NITDA), reported on Thursday, 29 October 2026. He said the date had not changed and that institutions that break the rule would face sanctions. Deliberate attempts to frustrate the policy would not be tolerated, he added.
## Why the rule exists

The CBN says storing payment data in the country will improve supervision, make the financial system more resilient and protect sensitive customer information, as more Nigerians rely on mobile apps, online banking and fintech services. The meeting focused on the National Sovereign Cloud Initiative, which aims to keep government and critical data on infrastructure within Nigeria.
## What banks must do

Yuguda reportedly stressed that simply moving data into the country will not make it safe. Banks must also improve their cybersecurity, plans for keeping services running during outages, disaster recovery and risk management. They will remain responsible for risks linked to cloud providers and other technology partners.
## What it means for customers

For ordinary customers, the change should be mostly invisible, but the regulator says it should make it harder for sensitive financial data to be exposed and easier for authorities to investigate fraud.
more: The deadline is 1 January 2027 and will not change.
Banks must also strengthen cybersecurity and backup plans.
Firms that break the rule face sanctions.

stories.h: Oliseh says Mikel snubbed him as Super Eagles coach and NFF warned him about three stars
stories.p: Former Super Eagles coach Sunday Oliseh has reportedly said that John Mikel Obi failed to turn up for a meeting he travelled to London to hold, calling it one of the biggest insults of his time in charge. He also claimed the NFF told him not to invite Mikel, Vincent Enyeama and Emmanuel Emenike.
body: Former Super Eagles head coach Sunday Oliseh has reopened old wounds from his time in charge of the national team, reportedly describing a snub by John Mikel Obi as one of the biggest insults he suffered in the job.
## What he said

Speaking on a podcast, in comments reported on Thursday, 29 October 2026, Oliseh is said to have explained that he paid for his own trip from Belgium to the United Kingdom to meet Mikel and Victor Moses at a bar in central London, together with his assistant coach. According to Oliseh, Moses came and gave honest feedback about problems in the squad, which he said he respected, but Mikel did not turn up and did not reply to his WhatsApp message.
## The NFF warning

Oliseh also reportedly said that when he took the job, officials of the Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) told him to stop inviting Mikel, goalkeeper Vincent Enyeama and striker Emmanuel Emenike, describing the three as troublesome for the federation. He said he now regrets not following that advice. The NFF has not commented on his account, and Mikel has not publicly responded.
## Background

Oliseh, a former Super Eagles captain, coached the national team from 2015 until he resigned in 2016. His spell was marked by public disputes with players and officials. Enyeama retired from international football during that period after a falling-out with the coach. Mikel, who captained Nigeria and won the 2013 Africa Cup of Nations, has since become a popular podcaster and pundit.
## How fans reacted
Fans were divided, with some saying the former coach should let the past go and others saying his account helps explain the tension in the team at the time.
more: Oliseh says Mikel ignored a meeting he travelled to London for.
He claims the NFF warned him against inviting Mikel, Enyeama and Emenike.
Mikel has not publicly responded.

stories.h: Osimhen closes in on Galatasaray's record for goals by a foreign player
stories.p: Victor Osimhen now has 68 goals for Galatasaray after his derby brace against Fenerbahçe, leaving him third on the club's list of top foreign scorers. Mauro Icardi holds the record with 77 goals.
body: Super Eagles striker Victor Osimhen is moving quickly up Galatasaray's list of all-time foreign goalscorers, and the club record is now within reach.
## Where he stands

Osimhen's two goals in Monday's 2-1 derby win over Fenerbahçe took his tally for the Istanbul club to 68, according to reports on Thursday, 29 October 2026. That puts him third among foreign players in the club's history. Romanian great Gheorghe Hagi is second with 72 goals, while Argentine striker Mauro Icardi holds the record with 77, just nine more than Osimhen.
## His form this season

The 27-year-old has reportedly scored nine goals and provided three assists in nine appearances in all competitions this season under coach Okan Buruk. His derby double was celebrated widely by Galatasaray fans and by Nigerians on social media.
## Background

Osimhen first joined Galatasaray on loan from Napoli and became a fan favourite after a prolific first season that helped the club win the Turkish league title. He later completed a permanent move. The former African Footballer of the Year remains Nigeria's main attacking threat, and his form will be closely watched by Super Eagles fans.
## What happens next
At his current rate, Osimhen could pass Hagi within weeks, and could challenge Icardi's record before the end of the season.
more: Osimhen has 68 goals for Galatasaray.
Mauro Icardi holds the foreign-player record with 77.
He scored twice in the derby win over Fenerbahçe.

stories.h: Trump calls Brazil's presidential election 'a disgrace' as Flavio Bolsonaro claims victory from the US
stories.p: US President Donald Trump has reportedly described Brazil's presidential election as a disgrace and declined to say whether he recognises Lula da Silva's victory. His comments came a day after Lula's rival, Flavio Bolsonaro, arrived in the United States and declared himself the rightful leader.
body: US President Donald Trump has reportedly called Brazil's presidential election a disgrace, raising tensions with Latin America's largest country.
## What he said

Asked by reporters on Thursday, 29 October 2026, whether he accepted the victory of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Trump reportedly described the election as a disgrace and an embarrassment to Brazilians, but said he did not want to say more at that time. He did not say whether he recognised Lula as Brazil's president.
## Background

Lula, a veteran left-wing leader, faced Flavio Bolsonaro, the son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, in the election. Flavio Bolsonaro, an ally of Trump, has claimed he was the true winner. He reportedly travelled to the United States the day before Trump's remarks, after going into exile from Brazil, and declared himself the rightful leader. Earlier this week, a Brazilian court had banned him from leaving the country, according to reports at the time.
## Why it matters

Trump's comments reportedly go further than his earlier remarks on the vote and are likely to strain relations between Washington and Brasília. The United States and Brazil are major trading partners, and relations were already tense after Trump imposed tariffs on Brazilian goods and criticised the prosecution of Jair Bolsonaro.
## What happens next
Brazil's government has not yet responded publicly to the latest comments, and it is not clear whether the United States will formally question the result.
more: Trump would not say whether he recognises Lula's win.
Flavio Bolsonaro declared himself the rightful leader after arriving in the US.
The comments are expected to strain US-Brazil relations.

stories.h: Habibat Jinadu says discrimination over her dark skin pushed her to bleach
stories.p: Veteran Yoruba actress Habibat Jinadu has reportedly said she bleached her skin after years of being told by directors that she was too dark for the camera. She said fair-skinned actors were favoured for roles when she started out.
body: Veteran Yoruba Nollywood actress Habibat Jinadu has spoken openly about why she lightened her skin, saying years of remarks about her complexion on film sets wore her down.
## What she said

In an interview with a BBC Yoruba programme, reported on Thursday, 29 October 2026, Jinadu reportedly said that directors repeatedly complained that she was too dark under the lights on set. She said she did not take the comments to heart at first, until someone compared her to a monkey. She said fair-skinned actors were often preferred for roles when she was building her career, and that people who were not light-skinned were rarely called for jobs. The constant criticism, she said, eventually led her to bleach her skin.
## Background

Jinadu has appeared in many Yoruba-language films over the years and is a familiar face to fans of the genre. Skin bleaching is a long-running issue in Nigeria and across Africa, and health experts have repeatedly warned about the dangers of some lightening creams. Other entertainers have spoken in the past about pressure to look a certain way on screen.
## How people reacted

Her comments started a wide conversation online. Many users said colourism remains a real problem in the entertainment industry, while others said no one should be made to feel ashamed of their natural skin. Some praised her for speaking honestly about a painful experience.
more: Jinadu says directors told her she was too dark for the camera.
She says fair-skinned actors were favoured for roles.
Her comments sparked a debate about colourism.

stories.h: Princess Shyngle raises alarm after card bearing her name was reportedly used in Lagos
stories.p: Gambian actress Princess Shyngle says someone used an American Express card bearing her name at a Lagos venue on Tuesday night. In an angry video, she said she has contacted the police and will use CCTV footage to find the person.
body: Gambian actress Princess Shyngle, known to Nigerian audiences from Nollywood films, has raised the alarm over what she says is a case of identity theft.
## What happened

In a video shared online and reported on Thursday, 29 October 2026, the actress said she had found out that someone went to a Lagos venue on Tuesday night and used an American Express card with her name on it. She said she had never imagined she could be a victim of identity theft.
## What she said she will do

Speaking angrily in the video, Shyngle said she would obtain the venue's CCTV footage to identify the person and expose them publicly, warning that she was coming for whoever was responsible. She said she had already reported the matter to the police. The venue has not commented publicly, and no arrest has been announced.
## Background

Shyngle has appeared in several Nollywood productions and has a large social media following. Identity theft and card fraud are growing concerns in Nigeria as more payments move online, and banks regularly warn customers to protect their card details and report suspicious transactions quickly.
## How people reacted
Fans sympathised with the actress and urged her to work with her bank and the police, while some shared their own experiences of card fraud.
more: She says the card was used at a Lagos venue on Tuesday night.
She has reported the matter to the police.
She plans to use CCTV footage to identify the person.

stories.h: Blord vs VDM: who is fooling who? Blord claims his power station can run a fridge, fan, TV and treadmill for 12 hours
stories.p: A day after VeryDarkMan's Ratel power station ran a TV, fan and fridge for 5 hours 17 minutes in his test, Blord has claimed his 1,000W unit can run a big fridge, an industrial fan, a TV and a treadmill for 12 hours. Nigerians are asking him to back it up with a full, uninterrupted test and to show its battery capacity.
body: Barely 24 hours after VeryDarkMan demonstrated the performance of his Ratel power station, Blord has come out with his own claims, and Nigerians are already raising serious questions.
According to Blord, his 1,000W-rated power station can power a big refrigerator, a 128W industrial fan, a television and even a treadmill for 12 solid hours!
Wait a minute! How is that possible?
VDM tested his 1,200W-rated power station, and it lasted 5 hours and 17 minutes under the conditions of his demonstration.
Now Blord is claiming his 1,000W unit can run all those appliances for 12 hours, without showing a complete, uninterrupted test to back up the claim.
Blord, Nigerians need evidence, not just words!

However, there is something important here. A power station's watt rating tells us how much power it can deliver at once, while its battery capacity, measured in watt-hours (Wh), determines how long it can run appliances. So battery life cannot be judged from the 1,000W and 1,200W ratings alone.
Blord, show us the battery capacity, connect all those appliances and let the test run for 12 hours. No editing, no shortcuts!
VDM has shown his demonstration. Nigerians are waiting to see yours.
Do you believe Blord's 12-hour claim, or should he prove it with a proper live test?

stories.h: Doris Ogala remanded in Lagos ahead of bail hearing as Sowore condemns detention
stories.p: Nollywood actress and Abia governorship candidate Doris Ogala has been remanded in a Lagos correctional centre after being arraigned over a complaint filed by Pastor Chris Okafor. Her bail application is due to be heard on Friday. Activist Omoyele Sowore has described the remand as an abuse of state power.
body: Nollywood actress Doris Ogala, who is the African Action Congress (AAC) candidate for governor of Abia State in 2027, has been remanded in a correctional centre in Lagos after appearing in court on Wednesday, 28 October 2026. Her application for bail is listed for hearing on Friday, 30 October.
## What happened

Ogala was arraigned before a Federal High Court in Lagos on three counts linked to a complaint by the cleric Pastor Chris Okafor. The charges relate to the alleged publication of photographs, the alleged spreading of false electronic messages and alleged threats against the pastor. She has not been convicted of anything, and the allegations are yet to be tested at trial.

News of the remand first spread on Wednesday afternoon, when comedian Deeone shared it online. Reports differ on which Lagos facility she was taken to. Before she was led away, Ogala posted a short video from the courtroom in which she described the case as a political move aimed at stopping her governorship bid. Clips of the moment she was taken out of court were shared widely on Thursday.
## Background

The dispute between Ogala and Okafor has played out on social media for months. It reportedly began after the pastor announced plans to marry another woman, which led Ogala to criticise him publicly. She has since spoken several times about their past relationship. In another video from court, she was also heard telling the judge that her former partner was using the law against her.
## How people reacted

Human rights activist and politician Omoyele Sowore condemned the remand in a Facebook post, calling it an abuse of power. He accused the police of repeatedly using the Cybercrimes Act to shield powerful people, argued that what he called a private quarrel should not have become a criminal case, and urged the courts to stay impartial. He also said her rights as a candidate must be protected. Online, fans were divided, with some backing the actress and others saying she should answer the charges in court.
## What happens next
All eyes are now on Friday's bail hearing in Lagos. Her party has not yet said how the case will affect her campaign in Abia.
more: Ogala faces three counts linked to a complaint by Pastor Chris Okafor; she denies wrongdoing and calls the case political.
Her bail application is due to be heard on Friday, 30 October.
Sowore says police are misusing the Cybercrimes Act.
